title: Hourly Drunk Drivers Auto-Dig:Kearns court-facility enrichment and news scan
summary: Dataset-first hourly pass added a source-bounded West Jordan Third District Court facility connection relevant to the Kearns DUI case, queued authoritative docket recovery, and found no material post-seed news update.

sources.title: 'There was nothing I could do,' recalls father of young victim killed by DUI driver

data.research_question: Can the selected Kearns DUI case be advanced with defensible public organizational-location evidence, and has materially new case news appeared since the existing July 28 seed packet?
data.method: Refreshed current main at 52420c03c47e092bf88b2471691fbd527acbb222 and re-read the live v0.9.0 schema/Auto-Dig/Free-Range/write/merge contract. Enumerated 27 physical dig roots; excluded free-range as the meta-root, leaving 26 research dataset/topic roots. Applied the previous-three successful hourly anti-repeat rule to cia, larry-fink, and graphika, leaving 23 dataset-stage candidates. Run seed 18288113832071084461 is the first 64 bits of SHA-256('52420c03c47e092bf88b2471691fbd527acbb222|2026-08-18T19:51:49-04:00'); uniform sampling over the sorted diversity-eligible roots selected drunk-drivers. The selected root contains one existing incident packet and no investigation-target records in its manifest, so the target-stage pool collapses to the single existing Kearns DUI case subject; target seed 4468281321018733648 is the first 64 bits of SHA-256(run-seed|drunk-drivers|target-stage-v1). HQ/location phase reviewed Utah Courts' current West Jordan District Court directory and Third District team page. The directory gives 8080 S Redwood Rd. Ste. 1701, West Jordan, UT 84088, while the team page places Judge Stephen Nelson under West Jordan; KSL identifies Nelson as Guzman's sentencing judge. The pass models that address only as a public organizational court facility, not headquarters, and adds no coordinates. It queues authoritative docket/judgment recovery before binding the existing case to a precise venue. Current-news searches for Charmayne Huerta Guzman, the Kearns crash, and Lennyn Lilic after the July 28 seed returned the prior 2024-2026 coverage but no material new post-cutoff development, so no filler event was created. Direct GitHub DNS is unavailable in the sandbox; connector-backed patch reconstruction is used locally and exact-head GitHub checks remain authoritative for the full corpus/site gate.
classification_rules: exclude previous three successful hourly roots when alternatives exist
avoid recent Los Angeles/New York dominant geography when alternatives exist
judge assignment plus news reporting does not by itself prove exact case venue
no news filler without material post-cutoff evidence

findings.finding: Utah State Courts lists West Jordan District Court at 8080 S Redwood Rd. Ste. 1701, West Jordan, UT 84088.
Utah State Courts places Judge Stephen Nelson in the West Jordan section of the Third District team directory.
KSL identifies Stephen Nelson as the judge who sentenced Charmayne Huerta Guzman.
The exact authoritative case number, sentencing venue binding, and signed judgment remain unresolved until the court docket/judgment is recovered.
No materially new post-July-28 case development was found in the bounded current-news scan.
